description: Get platform-specific options for a channel: Pinterest boards (or, with boardId, that board's sections), YouTube playlists, Tumblr blogs, Discord text channels, Threads location search. Returns type (which kind of option came back) and items, each with an id and a name; a TikTok channel returns info instead of items. Use this when you need a platform's valid post types before creating a post for it.

boardId.description: Pinterest only: the board's ID, digits only, sent as a string (from this tool's boards list). Returns that board's sections ({ type: 'sections', items: [{ id, name }] }) for platformSpecific.pinterest.boardSectionId, instead of the boards. Non-numeric values return 400.

channelId.description: The channel ID to get options for, from list_channels.

q.description: Search term. Threads: place search for platformSpecific.threads.locationId (returns { unavailable: true } until the channel has granted location tagging).

name: get_channel_options

info.description: Extra details for types that are not a list, such as creator_info.

items.description: The options of that type. Use an item's id in the matching platformSpecific field.

type.description: boards, sections, playlists, blogs, channels, locations or creator_info.

unavailable.description: Set when the options cannot be offered for this channel.

title: Get channel post-type options
